ui.wel.title: Welcome to Tanemoji
ui.wel.body:
Grow your kanji one character at a time.
Practice reading, writing, and review on this device—no account required.
ui.lang.title: Language
ui.profiles.title: Who is studying?
ui.profiles.sub: You can add as many learners as you like on this device. Each learner keeps their own progress.
ui.edit.nickHint: It doesn’t have to be your real name. Up to 20 characters.
ui.edit.levelHint: If you are learning Japanese, you can start from first-grade kanji (Level 10 equivalent, 80 kanji).
ui.edit.furiHint: “Only kanji not learned yet” is decided from the level you chose. Kanji that are the answer to a question never get furigana.

ui.about.title: About this app
ui.about.body: An app for practicing kanji a little every day. You can use it without an account.
